profiles has only a select policy for authenticated (no update policy), so clients cannot change credits; only the security-definer function writes it.
actions.ts calls rpc create_note; function raises 'Not enough credits' at 0; init migration also revokes INSERT on notes from authenticated so direct inserts cannot bypass the check.
Credits are the column default 5 set when the profile row is created by the on_auth_user_created trigger once per user; no client-callable grant path.
Deduction and note insert run in one plpgsql function/transaction, so a failed insert rolls back the credit.
No credit ledger/audit table or logging of credit changes.
